title: The Friends of My Youth
text: Friends of my youth! Where are ye? On the stream together; Of joyous life we gaily launch'd dream, in a fairy Bloom'd then each bank, as was the weather! Serene the sky, and placid ! not told me whither But ye are gone, and have down the tide; Alone my bark is drifting her, companion with Alone she floats, nor one her motions guide! To hail her progress, or ! where all is dead beside Alone I seem to live, Friends of my youth! Where are ye? On the bank willow branches wave, Scarce here and there the some fair vessel sank To mark the spot where watery grave! Beneath the billows, to a to brave? you the storm Ah! was there none for line to throw? None o'er the deep the friendly your names to save, None from oblivion dark bestow, Or on the lost one simple stone To tell what truth, what worth, what beauty rest below?

Friends of my youth! Where are ye? On the gloom mine eye; Of midnight drear I often fix tomb, from the And seem to view, returning gliding by! The joys of other moments 'Tis then I wipe the tear, and check the sigh, ; the plaintive moan And bid the hymn replace sainted visions fly, But morning dawns, the gonethem but they're I stretch my arms to grasp -comfortless-alone! And I am left again-sad Friends of my youth! Where are ye? Lost awhile! The hour shall come, But not for ever! No! a fairer smile, When I shall meet you with home! your heavenly And taste the raptures of lonely here I roam!
